description: Test suite for OpenClawKit's ChatViewModel, including helper functions to simulate chat interactions, mock transport, and a range of unit tests covering message handling, session management, model selection, and error scenarios.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A simple class to hold and record values asynchronously, used for callback state tracking.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An async actor used to coordinate asynchronous test flows by blocking and releasing threads.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: An async actor providing a thread-safe counter, used to count invocation attempts in tests.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: Keeps internal counters and logs of calls made within TestChatTransport for assertions.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport used to simulate chat events, manage responses, and track method calls during tests.

methods.name: chatTextMessage
methods.description: Constructs an AnyCodable message payload representing a chat message with role, text content, and timestamp.

methods.name: historyPayload
methods.description: Creates a mock history payload with optional session info and previous messages.

methods.name: sessionEntry
methods.description: Constructs a mock session entry with key, last updated timestamp, and optional model info.

methods.name: makeViewModel
methods.description: Sets up a test OpenClawChatViewModel with configurable responses and hooks, returning the transport and view model instances.

methods.name: loadAndWaitBootstrap
methods.description: Forces the view model to load and waits until it is bootstrap complete and session is loaded.

methods.name: sendUserMessage
methods.description: Simulates user input and triggers sending the message in the view model.

methods.name: sendMessageAndEmitFinal
methods.description: Sends a user message and emits a final response event, returning the run ID.

methods.name: emitToolStart
methods.description: Emits a tool call start event.

methods.name: emitExternalFinal
methods.description: Emits an external final chat event to simulate external termination.
